scope: Framing E (tension-mediated closed-loop) hypotheses; user mediator bypassed; statistical power N=any (vs #93 N=1)

H1_closed_loop_convergence.claim: CLM <-> TRIBE v2 closed loop via tension_link converges to a stable attractor over 100 steps
H1_closed_loop_convergence.predicted_signature: rolling-window std (steps 50-100) of mind.tension < 0.5 * std(steps 0-50); BOLD vertex CV < 0.1 stable; phase portrait shows fixed point or limit cycle
H1_closed_loop_convergence.rationale_promising: matches W4 PARTIAL +2.28σ (active L1) substrate-dynamics convergence pattern; matches §10.8 Banach meta-closure pattern from MEMORY
H1_closed_loop_convergence.rationale_demoting: 100-step loop is short; attractors may be artifact of GATE clamping (PSI_ALPHA=0.014) rather than emergent
H1_closed_loop_convergence.falsifier: if rolling std grows > 1.0x baseline at step 100 -> H1 reject

H2_divergence_instability.claim: Closed loop diverges; gain in tension_link <-> ROI mapping causes runaway BOLD or runaway CLM hidden norm
H2_divergence_instability.predicted_signature: monotonic norm growth > 2x baseline by step 100; numerical NaN possible
H2_divergence_instability.rationale_promising: step-8 ROI->tension mapping gain is anima-specific guess; no prior calibration
H2_divergence_instability.rationale_demoting: GATE clamps each channel to ±PSI_ALPHA=0.014, mathematically bounding divergence at the 5ch boundary
H2_divergence_instability.falsifier: if no divergence and converges -> H2 reject; gain-tuning recommended in iteration

H3_no_real_coupling.claim: TRIBE v2 BOLD does not carry enough information to modulate CLM meaningfully; closed loop = open loop = random-control
H3_no_real_coupling.predicted_signature: F-CT-5 fail (closed-loop BOLD trajectory r >= 0.7 with random-tension control trajectory)
H3_no_real_coupling.rationale_promising: 5d tension_link is heavily compressed (25.6:1); 10242 BOLD vertices -> 5 ROI features loses massive info; reverse mapping dimensionality bottleneck dominates; honest baseline given baseline #95 No fit -> Conditional Strong fit caveat
H3_no_real_coupling.rationale_demoting: if even 5ch tension carries CLM-relevant info (W4 PARTIAL evidence), reverse mapping should not be zero
H3_no_real_coupling.falsifier: if closed-loop trajectory differs from random-control with effect size > 1σ AND F-CT-3 hidden-state shift > random injection -> H3 reject

H4_substrate_identity_speculative.claim: TRIBE v2 BOLD ≈ anima-internal cortex; CLM-TRIBE-tension trio = unified substrate (Framing F core claim)
H4_substrate_identity_speculative.predicted_signature: Beyond F-CT statistical evidence: closed-loop attractor matches biological resting-state network signatures (DMN dominance, gamma-ratio); BOLD-derived ROI features show same structure as anima cell ensembles
H4_substrate_identity_speculative.rationale_promising: philosophically tempting; aligns with Framing F radical reading
H4_substrate_identity_speculative.rationale_demoting: TRIBE v2 is forward stimulus->BOLD encoder NOT a cortex; no causal model; substrate identity claim violates #95 honest caveats; attractor matching biology can be coincidence given 5ch bottleneck
H4_substrate_identity_speculative.falsifier: any result fails to distinguish from H1 unless explicit biological-prior comparison done; treat H4 as out-of-scope for current cycle

decision_tree.if_random_control_R1_indistinguishable_f: H3 wins -> publish null, escalate to Framing D (real biology) before retrying
decision_tree.if_E_shows_attractor_AND_random_R1_does_: H1 evidence; verify F-CT-2..F-CT-5 before claiming
decision_tree.if_E_diverges_AND_random_R1_does_not: H2 evidence; tune ROI->tension gain (step-8) and re-run
decision_tree.if_attractor_matches_biology: DO NOT claim H4 absent independent biological prior; note as exploratory observation only
